hospital_name: Deaconess Regional Healthcare Services Illinois, Inc. (Heartland Regional Medical Center)

evidence.quote: Patients whose family income is at or below 200% of the FPL are eligible to receive free care.

tiers.description: Income above 200% and up to 350% of FPL eligible for services at a discount rate; qualifying patients not charged more than AGB. Uninsured patients receive an automatic uninsured discount (facility-specific, 63.64% to 81%).
Above 350% FPL may be eligible for discounted rates case-by-case at hospital discretion (catastrophic illness, medical indigence).

evidence.quote: Patients whose family income is above 200% and up to 350% of the FPL are eligible to receive services at a discount rate.

asset_test.details: Policy says to consider the patient's available assets and all other financial resources; assets defined as banking accounts, cash on hand, CDs, securities, real estate, vehicles, and financial settlements, with supporting documentation required.

evidence.quote: Consider the patient’s available assets and all other financial resources available to the patient.
Uninsured patients must be permitted to apply for a discount within 90 days of the date of discharge/service.

presumptive_eligibility: Presumptive eligibility may be determined for homeless patients, public assistance eligibility, deceased patients with no known estate, and Medicaid non-covered charges.
warnings: The 90-day window applies to uninsured patients applying for the uninsured discount under the Hospital Uninsured Patient Discount Act; it is counted from date of discharge/service, and no deadline is stated for financial assistance generally.

Policy covers multiple facilities (Crossroads, Union County, Red Bud, TransCare EMS) with different uninsured discount percentages: Medical Center 81%, Crossroads 78.77%, Union County 63.64%, Red Bud 74.70%.
Section VI.B states the range as above 200% and less than 350% FPL, while Section VI.F says up to 350%; the more specific F was used.
Section VI.B says assistance applies to patients who lack assets to pay.
Policy limits collections to 20% of family income per 12-month period for uninsured patients.
No application address, phone, or portal given in the policy; websites listed refer to financial assistance pages.
Tier boundary: 200% and 350% shown as the policy states 'above 200% and up to 350%'.
